description: This file defines the Wishlist class within the OpenCart project, providing methods to add, delete, retrieve, and count wishlist entries for a customer, interacting with the database.

classes.name: Wishlist
classes.description: Provides CRUD operations for customer wishlist data, including adding, deleting, retrieving, and counting wishlist items.

methods.name: addWishlist
methods.description: Adds a product to the customer's wishlist, ensuring no duplicate entries by deleting existing ones for the same product and customer before inserting.

methods.name: deleteWishlists
methods.description: Deletes wishlist entries for a customer, optionally filtering by product ID.

methods.name: getWishlist
methods.description: Retrieves all wishlist records for a specified customer.

methods.name: getTotalWishlist
methods.description: Returns the total number of wishlist items for a customer.
